Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: A structured outline of the module's core topics—game design fundamentals, canvas drawing, animation loops, and event handling—used by learners to preview what will be covered and by instructors to organize lesson sequencing.

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics (HTML)
Artifacts.Description: Covers the foundational topics of Module 13—game design principles, defining objectives and rules, and structuring a browser-embedded game—serving as a learner's overview of what the module will teach before diving into coding.

Artifacts.Name: Game Design Fundamentals
Artifacts.Description: A reading that introduces the core principles of planning a browser game before coding, covering how to define objectives, establish rules, and create a game blueprint; learners read it to understand the design process that guides all subsequent coding decisions.

Artifacts.Name: Canvas Drawing for Games
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains the HTML5 Canvas API for browser game development, covering how to set up the canvas element, use the JavaScript drawing interface to render shapes and sprites, and update the display in real time; learners use it to gain the foundational drawing skills needed for game graphics.

Artifacts.Name: Animation and the Game Loop
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains the concept and implementation of the game loop in browser-based games, covering how requestAnimationFrame drives continuous frame updates, movement, collision checks, and score changes; learners use it to understand how to make a canvas game run and animate smoothly.

Artifacts.Name: Event Handling and Player Input
Artifacts.Description: A reading that covers JavaScript event handling for player input, explaining how to capture and respond to keyboard, mouse, and touch events to connect physical player actions to in-game behavior; learners use it to implement responsive controls in their browser games.

Artifacts.Name: Game Logic and State Management
Artifacts.Description: A reading that covers game logic and state management, explaining how to track and update game variables such as score, lives, and win/loss conditions over time so the game reacts correctly to player actions; learners use it to structure the rules and data flow of their games.

Artifacts.Name: Integrating and Assembling the Complete Game
Artifacts.Description: A reading that guides learners through combining all previously learned skills — canvas drawing, animation loops, input handling, and game logic — into a single cohesive, playable browser game project; learners use it as a capstone walkthrough for assembling a complete game.
